verses.restored: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.

familiar.text: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.

modern.text: I said, “I will watch my ways so that I will not sin with my tongue; I will guard my mouth with a muzzle as long as the wicked are present.”

verses.restored: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.

familiar.text: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.

modern.text: I was speechless and still; I remained silent, even from speaking good, and my sorrow was stirred.

original.text: נֶאֱלַ֣מְתִּי ד֭וּמִיָּה הֶחֱשֵׁ֣יתִי מִטּ֑וֹב וּכְאֵבִ֥י נֶעְכָּֽר

verses.restored: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,

familiar.text: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,

modern.text: My heart grew hot within me; as I mused, the fire burned. Then I spoke with my tongue:

original.text: חַם לִבִּ֨י בְּקִרְבִּ֗י בַּהֲגִיגִ֥י תִבְעַר אֵ֑שׁ דִּ֝בַּ֗רְתִּי בִּלְשֽׁוֹנִי

verses.restored: YHWH, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is: that I may know how frail I am.

familiar.text: LORD, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is: that I may know how frail I am.

modern.text: “Show me, O LORD, my end and the measure of my days. Let me know how fleeting my life is.

original.text: הוֹדִ֘יעֵ֤נִי יְהוָ֨ה קִצִּ֗י וּמִדַּ֣ת יָמַ֣י מַה הִ֑יא אֵ֝דְעָ֗ה מֶה חָדֵ֥ל אָֽנִי

verses.restored: Behold, you have made my days a few handbreadths, and my lifetime is as nothing before you; surely every human stands as a mere breath. Selah.

familiar.text: Behold, thou hast made my days as an handbreadth; and mine age is as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.

modern.text: You, indeed, have made my days as handbreadths, and my lifetime as nothing before You. Truly each man at his best exists as but a breath. Selah

original.text: הִנֵּ֤ה טְפָח֨וֹת נָ֘תַ֤תָּה יָמַ֗י וְחֶלְדִּ֣י כְאַ֣יִן נֶגְדֶּ֑ךָ אַ֥ךְ כָּֽל הֶ֥בֶל כָּל אָ֝דָ֗ם נִצָּ֥ב סֶֽלָה

verses.restored: Surely every man walketh in a vain show: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.

familiar.text: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.

modern.text: Surely every man goes about like a phantom; surely he bustles in vain; he heaps up riches not knowing who will haul them away.

original.text: אַךְ בְּצֶ֤לֶם יִֽתְהַלֶּךְ אִ֗ישׁ אַךְ הֶ֥בֶל יֶהֱמָי֑וּן יִ֝צְבֹּ֗ר וְֽלֹא יֵדַ֥ע מִי אֹסְפָֽם

verses.restored: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope is in thee.

familiar.text: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope is in thee.

modern.text: And now, O Lord, for what do I wait? My hope is in You.

original.text: וְעַתָּ֣ה מַה קִּוִּ֣יתִי אֲדֹנָ֑י תּ֝וֹחַלְתִּ֗י לְךָ֣ הִֽיא

verses.restored: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.

familiar.text: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.

modern.text: Deliver me from all my transgressions; do not make me the reproach of fools.

original.text: מִכָּל פְּשָׁעַ֥י הַצִּילֵ֑נִי חֶרְפַּ֥ת נָ֝בָ֗ל אַל תְּשִׂימֵֽנִי

verses.restored: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst it.

familiar.text: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst it.

modern.text: I have become mute; I do not open my mouth because of what You have done.

original.text: נֶ֭אֱלַמְתִּי לֹ֣א אֶפְתַּח פִּ֑י כִּ֖י אַתָּ֣ה עָשִֽׂיתָ

verses.restored: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.

familiar.text: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.

modern.text: Remove Your scourge from me; I am perishing by the force of Your hand.

original.text: הָסֵ֣ר מֵעָלַ֣י נִגְעֶ֑ךָ מִתִּגְרַ֥ת יָ֝דְךָ֗ אֲנִ֣י כָלִֽיתִי

verses.restored: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah.

familiar.text: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah.

modern.text: You discipline and correct a man for his iniquity, consuming like a moth what he holds dear; surely each man is but a vapor. Selah

original.text: בְּֽתוֹכָ֘ח֤וֹת עַל עָוֺ֨ן יִסַּ֬רְתָּ אִ֗ישׁ וַתֶּ֣מֶס כָּעָ֣שׁ חֲמוּד֑וֹ אַ֤ךְ הֶ֖בֶל כָּל אָדָ֣ם סֶֽלָה

verses.restored: Hear my prayer, O YHWH, and give ear to my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.

familiar.text: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.

modern.text: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear to my cry for help; do not be deaf to my weeping. For I am a foreigner dwelling with You, a stranger like all my fathers.

original.text: שִֽׁמְעָ֥ה תְפִלָּתִ֨י יְהוָ֡ה וְשַׁוְעָתִ֨י הַאֲזִינָה֮ אֶֽל דִּמְעָתִ֗י אַֽל תֶּ֫חֱרַ֥שׁ כִּ֤י גֵ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י עִמָּ֑ךְ תּ֝וֹשָׁ֗ב כְּכָל אֲבוֹתָֽי

verses.restored: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.

familiar.text: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.

modern.text: Turn Your gaze away from me, that I may again be cheered before I depart and am no more.”
